info.title: Configurite CLI
info.description: Command-line companion for the Configurite encrypted SQLite configuration provider. Migrate appsettings.json, rotate master keys, and inspect Configurite databases from the terminal.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: (migrate) Glob pattern whose values are encrypted. Repeatable.

options.name: --decrypt
options.description: (export) Decrypt and write secrets as plaintext.

options.name: --limit
options.description: (audit)  How many recent entries to print (default 20).

options.name: --follow
options.description:
(audit)  Tail the log for new entries (poll every 500 ms).
ENVIRONMENT
CONFIGURITE_MASTER_KEY  Default master key for encryption/decryption.
